+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+import inspect
+from inspect import Parameter
+from typing import TypedDict
+
+from _pytest.compat import num_mock_patch_args
+from _pytest.compat import signature
+
+
+class _FixtureContract(TypedDict):
+    name: str
+    required: list[str]
+
+
+def fixture_contract(
+    function: Callable[..., object], cls: type | None = None
+) -> _FixtureContract:
+    """Return the function's name and required fixture arguments in signature order."""
+    parameters = signature(function).parameters.values()
+    name = function.__name__
+    skip = num_mock_patch_args(function) if hasattr(function, "__wrapped__") else 0
+    if (
+        cls is not None
+        and not inspect.ismethod(function)
+        and not isinstance(inspect.getattr_static(cls, name, None), staticmethod)
+    ):
+        skip += 1
+
+    # Receivers and mocks occupy positional slots even if those slots aren't fixtures.
+    required = [
+        parameter.name
+        for index, parameter in enumerate(parameters)
+        if parameter.default is Parameter.empty
+        and (
+            parameter.kind is Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
+            or (parameter.kind is Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD and index >= skip)
+        )
+    ]
+    return {"name": name, "required": required}

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from _pytest.fixture_contract import fixture_contract
+from _pytest.monkeypatch import MonkeyPatch
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_fixture_contract_parameter_kinds() -> None:
+    def sample(
+        positional: object,
+        /,
+        first: object,
+        optional: object = None,
+        *args: object,
+        second: object,
+        optional_keyword: object = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert fixture_contract(sample) == {
+        "name": "sample",
+        "required": ["first", "second"],
+    }
+
+
+def test_fixture_contract_methods() -> None:
+    class Base:
+        def method(self, fixture: object) -> None:
+            pass
+
+        def positional_self(self, /, fixture: object) -> None:
+            pass
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def static(fixture: object) -> None:
+            pass
+
+    class Subclass(Base):
+        pass
+
+    assert fixture_contract(Subclass.method, Subclass)["required"] == ["fixture"]
+    assert fixture_contract(Subclass().method, Subclass)["required"] == ["fixture"]
+    assert fixture_contract(Subclass.positional_self, Subclass)["required"] == [
+        "fixture"
+    ]
+    assert fixture_contract(Subclass.static, Subclass)["required"] == ["fixture"]
+
+
+def test_fixture_contract_mock_injection() -> None:
+    class Example:
+        target = None
+
+    @patch.object(Example, "target", new=None)
+    @patch.object(Example, "target")
+    @patch.object(Example, "target")
+    def sample(positional_mock: object, /, mock: object, fixture: object) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert fixture_contract(sample) == {"name": "sample", "required": ["fixture"]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("attribute", "error"), [("__signature__", TypeError), ("__wrapped__", ValueError)]
+)
+def test_fixture_contract_propagates_signature_errors(
+    monkeypatch: MonkeyPatch, attribute: str, error: type[Exception]
+) -> None:
+    def sample() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sample, attribute, sample, raising=False)
+    with pytest.raises(error):
+        fixture_contract(sample)
